sentences.ar: بنفس اليوم، بيكي عملت رحلة لكل أولاد الصف.
sentences.en: That same day, Becky held a picnic for all the children of the class.
A steamboat, the river, food, and a cave.

sentences.ar: والأمهات قالوا: الأولاد بيناموا عند أصحابهم بعد الرحلة.
sentences.en: And the mothers said: the children sleep at friends' houses after the picnic.
So they do not come back at night.

sentences.ar: وتوم راح، طبعاً، وبيكي جنبه، والخطوبة رجعت زي ما كانت.
sentences.en: And Tom went, of course, with Becky beside him, and the engagement was back as it had been.

sentences.ar: وركبوا الباخرة، ونزلوا عند المغارة الكبيرة.
sentences.en: And they boarded the steamboat, and got off at the big cave.
McDougal's Cave: a small door in the mountain.

sentences.ar: وجواتها ممرات وأوض وطرق بلا نهاية.
sentences.en: And inside, passages and chambers and paths without end.

sentences.ar: كل ولد بيعرف أول كم ممر.
sentences.en: Every child knew the first few passages.

sentences.ar: وما حدا بيعرف آخرها، لأنه ما حدا وصل لآخرها.
sentences.en: And no one knew the end of it, because no one had reached the end.

sentences.ar: دخلوا بالشمع، وصار كل واحد يركض بممر، ويصرخ، ويضحك.
sentences.en: They went in with candles, and each ran down a passage, shouting, laughing.

sentences.ar: والصوت بيرجع من الحيطان، والظل بيرقص.
sentences.en: And the sound echoed from the walls, and the shadows danced.

sentences.ar: وتوم وبيكي مشوا سوا، أبعد شوي من الباقي.
sentences.en: And Tom and Becky walked together, a little farther than the rest.
And then farther.

sentences.ar: لقوا ممر ما فيه أسماء عالحيط، يعني ما حدا وصل له.
sentences.en: They found a passage with no names on the wall, meaning no one had reached it.
And Tom wrote his name and hers in candle smoke.

sentences.ar: ولقوا نبع، وبحيرة زغيرة، وسقف فيه أحجار بتلمع زي النجوم.
sentences.en: And they found a spring, a small lake, and a ceiling with stones shining like stars.

sentences.ar: وقالت بيكي: توم، صار لنا كتير.
sentences.en: And Becky said: Tom, it has been a long time.
Let us go back.
And Tom said: fine.
And they walked back.
And they walked.
And walked.
And did not see the names on the wall.
Tom said: this way.
No, this way.
And every passage looked like the one before.
And Becky said: Tom, are we lost?
And Tom said: no.
But they were.
And far off, at the steamboat, the children boarded and went home.

sentences.ar: وكل واحد فكر إن توم وبيكي عند حدا تاني.
sentences.en: And everyone thought Tom and Becky were with someone else.
